results.question: Are convolutional networks better than vision transformers for image classification on small datasets?
results.answer: Yes, convolutional neural networks generally outperform standard vision transformers when trained from scratch on small image datasets, primarily because vision transformers lack inherent locality inductive biases [arxiv:2111.11067#1, arxiv:2112.13492#1].
